mapper.select: select b.id, e.id equipmentId, e.name equipmentName, e.category equipmentCategory, e.deposit equipmentDeposit, b.borrow_time borrowTime, b.expected_return_time expectedReturnTime, b.actual_return_time actualReturnTime, b.status from borrow b join equipment e on b.equipment_id=e.id where user_id=#{id} order by b.updated_at desc

select b.id, u.username, u.email, e.id equipmentId, e.name equipmentName, e.category equipmentCategory, e.sub_category equipmentSubCategory, e.deposit equipmentDeposit, b.borrow_time borrowTime, b.expected_return_time expectedReturnTime, b.actual_return_time actualReturnTime, b.status from borrow b join equipment e on b.equipment_id=e.id join users u on b.user_id=u.id order by b.updated_at desc
